subject: Priority response & capacity roadmap for upcoming renewal
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@strato.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 08:14:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal window + support needs — Q3 usage spike

Hi Jordan,

We're coming up on our renewal for Strato AI (seat + inference) and wanted to surface a couple things before the renewal conversation:

- Q2 consumption is 2.6x our baseline and looks like it will stay elevated given the new recommendation feature we shipped. I've attached the Q2 usage export.
- We need a clearer latency commitment for the 1k-10k TPS burst profiles — the business is sensitive to tail latency right now.
- Our platform team also wants a path to higher support (faster response + a named technical lead) if we upsell reserved capacity.

Can Redwood outline an elevated support + capacity option and a rough commercial tradeoff? Procurement is already looping in legal and will want draft terms if we move forward.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Platform
Strato AI

Attachments: strato_usage_q2.csv (CSV, 98KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@strato.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 09:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal window + support needs — Q3 usage spike

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and the usage export. I ran this by Camila (AM) and Laura (Customer Ops) and we sketched a pragmatic two-phase plan that balances latency SLAs, dedicated capacity, and term options. Summary below — happy to jump on a call this week to walk through.

Proposal (high level):
1) Phase A — Immediate renewal add-on (12 months):
   - Premium Response Tier: 1-hour P1 response, 24/7 on-call, priority queueing
   - Latency SLO: 99.9% requests < 180ms p50/p95 for steady-state; 99.5% tail for 10k TPS bursts (we'll define burst window)
   - Reserved baseline: +40% committed capacity (hot standby), burst pool available at on-demand rates
   - Pricing: incremental uplift ~12% on current ARR (proposal doc attached)

2) Phase B — 12–24 month capacity ladder (optional):
   - 24-month term: deeper discount (18%) and guaranteed burst slab with pre-warmed satellites in eu-west region
   - Named Technical Lead + quarterly ops review included for the 24-month option

Next steps:
- If this looks directionally right, Camila will prepare a mutual action plan with milestones (SOW, onboarding window, DocuSign).
- Laura will follow up with a brief runbook for the onramp (oncall roster, escalation path, early-warning metrics).

I'm attaching the draft Premium SLA language we normally propose for customers in this situation — it's intentionally prescriptive so the legal teams have a concrete starting point.

Would Tuesday 7/25 10am CET work for a 30-min sync?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, EMEA
Redwood Inference
T: +44 20 5555 0133

Attachments: Redwood_PremiumSLA_v2.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Elena Rossi <elena@strato.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@strato.ai
Date: Wed, 24 Jul 2028 11:02:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Renewal window + support needs — Q3 usage spike

Jordan —

Thanks, this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side after internal sync:
- Legal is pushing for contract language that explicitly calls out data residency and audit logs retention; they asked if Redwood can guarantee EU-only data plane for the pre-warmed satellites.
- Procurement is comfortable with a 12-month extension if we can get the 1-hour P1 response and the 99.5% burst tail commitment in writing. They will prefer a single PO vs. multiple invoices.
- For the named TL, we'd like a Bi-weekly 30-min technical review for the first 6 weeks of the onramp.

We're attaching a completed Security Questionnaire and the procurement contact details. If Redwood can confirm residency and provide a simple one-page addendum for the SLOs, we can aim to sign next week.

Elena

Attachments: Strato_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 250KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@strato.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 16:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal window + support needs — Q3 usage spike

Elena — appreciate the fast turnaround and for sending the security questionnaire. Key confirmations and commitments below (so Procurement/Legal have a single place to reference):

- EU-only data plane: we can guarantee EU-only data plane for the pre-warmed satellites (eu-west). We'll include the residency clause in the addendum.
- SLO addendum: we can commit to the 1-hour P1 response and a burst tail SLO of 99.5% for the negotiated burst window (definition included in the attached SLA draft).
- Billing preference: we can accept a single PO for the 12-month term. Camila will route pricing to finance to create a single-invoice schedule.
- Named TL & reviews: named TL assigned at go-live; Bi-weekly 30-min technical reviews for first 6 weeks are included for the 12-month Premium Response Tier.

Commercial options (final):
- 12-month Premium Response Tier: +12% uplift; single PO; immediate onramp (preferred by Strato per our notes).
- 24-month Premium Capacity Ladder: +2% effective after discount applied (18% total discount off list), includes guaranteed burst slab and extended governance. Requires 30-day lead for pre-warmed satellites.

Action items:
- Camila: prepare mutual action plan + DocuSign (target: send 7/26).
- Laura: draft onramp runbook and named TL intro doc.
- Jordan: coordinate residency addendum with legal and attach to DocuSign envelope.

I'll keep this thread updated. If you want the DocuSign live sooner, holler and we'll accelerate.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Strato onto the Premium track.

—Jordan
